![What's new in cheek 0.2.1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mailo037/cheek/v0.2.1/docs/releases/v0.2.1.png)

cheek 0.2.1 fixes resuming a ranged download with a different connection count.

- An interrupted download now continues with the chunks it saved, even when `-N` changed in between. Before, a different `-N` picked a different chunk size, the saved progress no longer matched and the download started over. Hamstr changes `-N` whenever the number of parallel downloads changes, so paused downloads there lost their progress.

Includes binaries for Linux, Windows, macOS and all three Android ABIs used by Hamstr. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
